title: Hoshino Ichika — My All In This Sound〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I overslept a little bit, but I still managed to get in on time.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Great show yesterday!
You and your band put on such a fun performance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, she came up to talk to me when the lineup was announced too.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: You've all improved so much since the last time I saw you play over at that live house! I was so surprised!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Yeah! And that solo relay you two did was super duper cool!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We spent a lot of time practicing it, so I really appreciate you saying that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We really wanted to grab hold of the audience's attention and turn the arena on its head.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Turn the arena on its head...
Yeah, that was just about when everyone around me started cheering too. The temperature just kept going up.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Especially during the second song... How do I describe it...? It felt like we'd become a part of your band's performance, Hoshino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You'd become a part of our performance...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line:
Yeah! That moment, I felt like you and the others...
No, it felt like all of us in that arena had become one.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for saying that! I felt the same way...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, keep up the amazing work! I'm really rooting for all of you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I did feel something like a connection to everyone during the show...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (But to actually hear that from someone who was there...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You seemed kind of happy just now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
I just got to talk to a girl who came and saw our show yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She said that she had a lot of fun, so I'm really glad that we put so much effort into it.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see. That is nice to hear.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The same thing actually happened to me just now by the main entrance.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes. She was a first-year, and that show was the first time she'd heard of us.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She even said that she liked the songs we played, and listened to them this morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Really?
It's so encouraging to hear directly back from audience members like this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It proves that we were able to connect with them. And I feel like working even harder now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Me too. I know we just finished a show, but I'm already looking forward to playing for them again.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, Ichika, let's keep doing our best today, and in the future.
